title: Gitea tag past 1.22
msg: Gitea {tag} is past 1.22. Forgejo supports a transparent upgrade only from Gitea up to v1.22 included; from 1.23 on there is no supported path, only best effort with manual database edits.
fix: Keep production on gitea/gitea:1.22.x and switch from a 1.22 backup, or migrate repo by repo through the Forgejo migration UI/API.

title: Gitea tag floats past 1.22
msg: gitea/gitea:{tag} is not pinned to 1.22.x. The next pull resolves to a release past 1.22 and closes the transparent upgrade path to Forgejo.
fix: Pin gitea/gitea:1.22.x (or 1.22.x-rootless) until the switch is done.

title: First hop from Gitea is not Forgejo v10.0
msg: Forgejo {tag} on Gitea data. The documented path is two steps: Gitea up to v1.22.x -> Forgejo v10.0.x, then v10.0.x -> any later Forgejo.
fix: Start the Gitea data on forgejo:10.0.x once, let it migrate, then change the tag to the current LTS.

title: Forgejo major past end of life
msg: Forgejo {major}.0 reached end of life on {eol} and gets no security fixes after that date.
fix: Move to Forgejo 15.0 LTS (supported until 2027-07-15) or the current stable major.

title: Forgejo major ends within 45 days
msg: Forgejo {major}.0 reaches end of life on {eol}, {days} days after {today}.
fix: Plan the move to Forgejo 15.0 LTS (supported until 2027-07-15) or the next stable major before {eol}.

title: Forgejo tag not pinned to a major
msg: forgejo:{tag} is not pinned to a major version. A pull can jump several majors at once, including past the v10.0 hop.

title: Gitea act_runner next to Forgejo
msg: gitea/act_runner:{tag} is Gitea's runner. Forgejo Actions is documented and supported with the Forgejo runner.
fix: Use code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner and re-register it against the Forgejo instance.

title: Custom Forgejo build is GPL v3+
msg: This file builds its own image next to Forgejo. Forgejo is GPL v3+ from v9.0 (MIT up to and including v8.0); a modified build you hand to others carries GPL source obligations.
fix: Keep the patch source published with the image, or use the stock image.
